newsitem.title: FRANCE: French privatisations seen at 22 bln Ffr this year.
newsitem.headline: French privatisations seen at 22 bln Ffr this year.

text.p: The French government has raised 15 billion francs so far this year from privatisations and expects to reach its target of 22 billion francs by the end of 1996, a finance ministry source said on Thursday.
"Between now and the end of the year we should be able to reach 22 billion francs," the source said.
The government said on Wednesday it expected to raise 27 billion francs from privatisations in 1997.
The source said on Thursday this money would be used to recapitalise state-owned companies.
The government is due to sell 49 percent of France Telecom next year.
